name: Pet Simulator 99
tagline: Pet Simulator 99 code list — active and expired codes for diamonds, lucky boosts and rare pets.
description: Pet Simulator 99 is BIG Games' flagship Roblox title where players collect pets, hatch eggs and grind for diamonds. Unlike most Roblox games, BIG Games rarely releases free in-game text codes — most codes are distributed via physical merchandise (PSX TCG packs, plushies, real-world pet toys) or short-lived live-event drops. As of mid-May 2026 there are no public free codes active, but this page is refreshed whenever BIG Games releases a free promo code or hosts a milestone event.

redeemSteps.title: Launch Pet Simulator 99
redeemSteps.detail: Open Roblox and start any Pet Simulator 99 session.

redeemSteps.title: Open the Settings menu
redeemSteps.detail: Tap the Settings (gear) icon on the right side of the screen.

redeemSteps.title: Find the Codes box
redeemSteps.detail: Inside Settings, scroll to the Codes input box.

redeemSteps.title: Enter the code
redeemSteps.detail: Type or paste the code exactly. Pet Simulator 99 codes are case-sensitive and usually all lowercase.

redeemSteps.title: Hit Submit
redeemSteps.detail: Working codes deliver the reward instantly. If the box flashes red, the code is invalid or expired.

faq.question: Why are there no active Pet Simulator 99 codes right now?
faq.answer: BIG Games' main code-distribution channel for PS99 is physical merchandise — boxed plushies, the PSX trading card game, and licensed pet toys each include a unique code. Free public codes are reserved for short milestone events (visit count goals, anniversaries) and tend to expire within hours.

faq.question: How do I get a code from Pet Simulator 99 merchandise?
faq.answer: Each official BIG Games product ships with a unique scratch-off or printed code. Redeem it once, in-game, on the account you want to receive the pet or item. Codes are not transferable between accounts after redemption.

faq.question: Are Pet Simulator 99 codes one-time use?
faq.answer: Yes — each code can only be redeemed once per Roblox account. Merchandise codes are also one-time per code (you cannot share a single code across multiple accounts).

faq.question: When should I use luck and boost codes?
faq.answer: If a public boost code does drop, stack luck codes immediately before opening high-tier eggs, and use diamond boosts right before a long grinding session for maximum benefit.
